body:
Fixes part of https://ripplelabs.atlassian.net/browse/VODF-208.

Feedback is that we don't document that **a Batch whose legs all failed validates with outer tesSUCCESS**.

We do document this in the Concept and Tutorial pages, but the Reference page for Batch does not, so it's worth adding something there also.
title: VODF-208 Batch transaction result explanation
